cards.text: Jeremiah, the LORD's prophet, just stood in the courtyard of the house of the LORD and announced that every disaster the LORD warned about is coming on Jerusalem. Somebody important is listening. Pashhur the priest, son of Immer and the chief official in the house of the LORD, hears Jeremiah prophesying these things.

cards.question: Pashhur, the chief official in the house of the LORD, hears Jeremiah's message of disaster. What does Pashhur do to Jeremiah?

answers.text: Has him beaten and put in the stocks
Asks him to pray for the whole city
Brings him before the elders to explain

cards.text: Beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, right by the house of the LORD. Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, and even I'm saying that's a rough night.

cards.question: Pashhur lets Jeremiah out of the stocks on the ___ day.

cards.text: The next day, Pashhur lets him go. Me? After a night in the stocks, I'm out of there QUIET and I'm out of there FAST.

cards.question: Fresh out of the stocks, Jeremiah speaks to Pashhur. What does Jeremiah do?

answers.text: Gives him a new name from the LORD
Thanks him for letting him go free

cards.text: Jeremiah tells him, “The LORD does not call you Pashhur, but Magor-missabib.” The Millers carved my name on my handle with love. This one? Pashhur's gonna want to hear the explanation.

cards.question: Jeremiah explains Pashhur's new name with what the LORD says. What will the LORD make Pashhur?

answers.text: A terror to himself and his friends
A leader of the exiles in Babylon
A watchman over the city walls

cards.question: The LORD says Pashhur's friends will fall by the sword far away, where Pashhur won't see it.

cards.text: Before his very eyes. OOF. And the LORD's message doesn't stop with Pashhur and his friends. It reaches all of Judah.

cards.question: The LORD says He will hand all of Judah over to someone. Who?

cards.text: The king of Babylon will carry them away to Babylon and put them to the sword. Then the LORD turns to everything the city owns.

cards.question: The LORD talks about all the wealth of Jerusalem, even the treasures of the kings of Judah. What happens to it?

answers.text: Enemies carry it off to Babylon
It gets buried under the temple
It goes to the poor of Judah

cards.text: Products, valuables, the kings' treasures, all plundered, seized and carried off. Friend, that's not a tow truck taking your car. That's a tow truck taking the WHOLE CITY.
Then the LORD comes right back around to the man who put the prophet in the stocks.

cards.question: Pashhur will go into captivity, and he will die and be buried in ___.
Pashhur goes into captivity alone, and everyone who lives in his house stays behind.
The LORD says Pashhur has been prophesying the truth to his friends all along.

cards.text: Lies. From the chief official in the house of the LORD. Pashhur kept the LORD's prophet in the stocks for one night, and now the LORD has told Pashhur where he'll be buried.

findings.problem: Card 3 says Jeremiah's time in the stocks was 'a rough night.' That tells the baker he was out by the next day, which gives away card 4 ('next') and rules out 'third' and 'seventh.'

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'A leader of the exiles in Babylon' names Babylon and exile before the passage brings them up. That points the baker to 'The king of Babylon' on card 11 and to 'Babylon' on card 16. Replace it with a wrong answer that doesn't mention Babylon or exile.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: 'The next day, Pashhur lets him go.' only repeats card 4's answer and adds nothing new from the passage. The joke is the only new thing on the card. Its 'QUIET' and 'FAST' set up a contrast that hints Jeremiah won't stay quiet, which leans the baker away from card 6's wrong answers.

The closing card mostly repeats what earlier cards already covered: the 'lies' answer from card 18, the night in the stocks from cards 2 to 5, and the burial in Babylon from card 16. It doesn't move the passage forward.
